scripts.build:binary: bun run build:dashboard && bun run build:embed-dashboard && bun packages/server/build/build-binary.ts
scripts.build:binary:all: bun run build:dashboard && bun run build:embed-dashboard && bun packages/server/build/build-binary.ts --all
scripts.build:dmg: bun run build:binary && mkdir -p packages/app/resources && cp -R packages/server/dist/$(node -e "console.log(process.platform+'-'+process.arch.replace('x64','x64').replace('arm64','arm64'))") packages/app/resources/server && bun --cwd packages/app run build:dmg
